recipes.name: Mushroom Pasta inspired by The Super Mario Bros Movie
ingredients: 1 tbsp kosher salt plus more as needed
6 oz white button mushrooms, washed, dried and sliced
1 clove garlic, peeled, minced, or crushed
1 tbsp parsley, chopped plus more to garnish
freshly ground black pepper, to taste
1 tbsp kosher salt, plus more as needed
6 oz shiitake mushrooms, trimmed and sliced
4 oz oyster mushrooms, trimmed and sliced
1 clove garlic, peeled, minced, or crushed
1/3 cup parmesan cheese, plus more to garnish
1/2 tsp kosher salt, plus more to taste
4 oz Cremini mushrooms, stems removed and finely chopped
1 tbsp parsley, chopped and more to garnish
freshly ground black pepper, to taste
instructions: For Simple Mushroom Pasta:

Bring a large pot of water to a boil and season with salt. Add the dried pasta and cook until the pasta is about 1 minute shy of al dente. - 1 tbsp kosher salt plus more as needed - 8 oz dried spaghetti

Meanwhile, add the oil and butter to a large high-wallet skillet and heat over medium heat. Season the melted butter/oil with a sprinkling of salt, then add the mushrooms to the skillet. Cook until the mushrooms have lost all of their moisture and have started to brown, about 5-7 minutes. - 1 tbsp olive oil - 1 tbsp unsalted butter - 1 tbsp kosher salt plus more as needed - 6 oz white button mushrooms washed, dried and sliced
Add the shallot and cook for 2-3 minutes or until the shallots begin to turn translucent. - ½ small shallot finely chopped
Add the garlic and cook for an additional 30 seconds or until fragrant. - 1 clove garlic peeled, minced, or crushed

Deglaze the pan with the wine and cook until the liquid has reduce by about half of its original volume, about 2-3 minutes. Add the red pepper flakes (if using) and parsley and cook for 30 seconds. - ⅓ cup dry white wine - ¼ tsp crushed red pepper flakes (optional) - 1 tbsp parsley chopped plus more to garnish

Turn the heat to medium-low, then stir in the heavy cream and lemon zest (if using). Continue cooking the sauce is gently simmering and has thickened, 1-2 minutes. - ¾ cup heavy cream - 1 tsp lemon zest (optional)
Add in the nearly al dente spaghetti and toss to combine. Add the pasta cooking water, ¼ cup at a time, as necessary until the sauce is glossy and coats the pasta well. - 8 oz dried spaghetti

Turn off the heat and stir in the parmesan cheese. Add more pasta cooking water if the sauce gets too thick. Season the pasta to taste with salt and pepper. - ½ cup parmesan cheese grated - freshly ground black pepper to taste
Serve in a large platter and garnish with more chopped parsley. - 1 tbsp parsley chopped plus more to garnish
For Miso Mushroom Pasta:

Bring a large pot of water to a boil and season with salt. Add the dried pasta and cook until the pasta is about 1 minute shy of al dente. - 1 tbsp kosher salt plus more as needed - 8 oz dried bucatini

Meanwhile, add the oil to a high-wallet skillet and heat over medium heat. Season the heated oil with a sprinkling of salt, then add the mushrooms to the skillet. Cook until the mushrooms have lost all of their moisture and have started to brown, about 5-7 minutes. - 1 tbsp olive oil - 1 tbsp kosher salt plus more as needed - 6 oz shiitake mushrooms trimmed and sliced - 4 oz oyster mushrooms trimmed and sliced
Add the shallot and cook for 2-3 minutes or until the shallots begin to turn translucent. - ½ shallot finely chopped
Add the garlic and cook for an additional 30 seconds or until fragrant. - 1 clove garlic peeled, minced, or crushed
Deglaze with the sherry and cook until the liquid has reduce by about half of its original volume, about 1-2 minutes. - 3 tbsp sherry

Transfer the ⅔ of the mushroom mixture to a high powered blender with butter, miso, and parmesan cheese. Blend until completely smooth; if the sauce is too thick to properly blend, add about ¼ cup of the pasta cooking water to the blender. - 2 tbsp red or white miso - ⅓ cup parmesan cheese plus more to garnish - 3 tbsp unsalted butter room temperature

Return the mushroom sauce to the skillet with the remaining cooked mushrooms. Bring the sauce up to a bare simmer over medium heat. - 6 oz shiitake mushrooms trimmed and sliced - 4 oz oyster mushrooms trimmed and sliced
Add in the nearly al dente pasta and toss to combine. Add the pasta cooking water, ¼ cup at a time, as necessary until the sauce is glossy and coats the pasta well. - 8 oz dried bucatini
Stir in the lemon juice and tarragon, then season to taste with salt and pepper. - ½ lemon juiced - 2 tsp chopped tarragon - 1 tbsp kosher salt plus more as needed
Garnish with more cheese and chopped parsley. - chopped parsley to garnish
For Norcina Pasta:

Bring a large pot of water to a boil and season with 1 tablespoon of salt. Add the dried pasta and cook until the pasta is about 1 minute shy of al dente. - 1 tbsp kosher salt - 8 oz dried Mezze rigatoni

Meanwhile, combine the pork, 1 clove of garlic, rosemary, fennel seeds, red pepper flakes, nutmeg and ½ teaspoon of salt in a medium bowl. Fold the thoroughly combine the mixture. - 8 oz ground pork - 2 garlic cloves minced and divided - 1 tsp fresh rosemary chopped - ¼ tsp fennel seeds crushed - ¼ tsp crushed red pepper flakes - ⅛ tsp freshly grated nutmeg - ½ tsp kosher salt plus more to taste

Add the oil to a large high-wallet skillet and heat over medium heat. Add the pork to the skillet, brown the meat, making sure to break the chunks into smaller pieces. Continue to cook for 3-4 minutes or until the pork is cooked through. - 1 tbsp olive oil - 8 oz ground pork

Using a slotted spoon, remove the cooked pork from the skillet and set side in a paper towel-lined bowl. Add the finely chopped mushrooms to the skillet and cook until they have released all of their moisture, 3-5 minutes. - 8 oz ground pork
Add the remaining garlic clove and cook for 30 seconds or until fragrant. - 2 garlic cloves minced and divided

Add the wine and cook until the liquid has reduced by about half of its original volume, about 2-3 minutes. Stir in the parsley and cook for 30 seconds longer. - ⅓ cup dry white wine - 1 tbsp parsley chopped and more to garnish
Turn the heat to low, then stir in the heavy cream and reserved pork. Continue cooking until the sauce has thickened, about 1-3 minutes. - ¾ cup heavy cream - 8 oz ground pork

Add in the nearly al dente pasta and toss to combine. Add the pasta cooking water, ¼ cup at a time, as necessary until the sauce is glossy and coats the pasta well. Then, add the pecorino cheese, and stir to combine. - 8 oz dried Mezze rigatoni - ½ cup Pecorino cheese
Season the pasta to taste with salt and pepper. - ½ tsp kosher salt plus more to taste - freshly ground black pepper to taste
Serve in a large platter and garnish with more chopped parsley. - 1 tbsp parsley chopped and more to garnish
